predecessors.name: British Colonial Empire
predecessors.text: the Colony of Fiji, which 'operated as a Crown colony until 1970' (founded by the Deed of Cession of 10 October 1874)

ledger.x: 1970: Fiji becomes independent from the United Kingdom as the Dominion of Fiji.
1987: after two military coups Fiji is declared a republic.
1997: the Republic of Fiji becomes the Republic of the Fiji Islands under the new constitution.
2011: the official name reverts to Republic of Fiji.

certainty.note: Island coasts; maritime limits are not drawn.
